name: Vacation Reconnaissance
description: Build a crawl-free vacation reconnaissance report for a required location using a 7-day weather forecast, Tripadvisor attractions and restaurants, Google Local places, recent Google News, Google Images Light, an optional Stash snapshot, and Canvas. It does not search lodging, make reservations, or use the configured default location when the command omits a destination.

steps.abort_speech: Vacation reconnaissance requires a valid location after the command, for example /vacation_reconnaissance Seaside, Oregon.
steps.description: Get the required destination's current weather and 7-day forecast
Find Tripadvisor attractions and activities without paid enrichment fan-out
Find current Google Local activity and place candidates
Gather a bounded recent local-news pulse without crawling articles
Find representative public images without downloading them

params.name: vacation_recon_${filename_timestamp}.txt

steps.description: Optionally save the bounded reconnaissance evidence to Stash
Create the dated Canvas vacation reconnaissance report

success_speech: Vacation reconnaissance for ${location} is ready in Canvas.
abort_speech: Vacation reconnaissance could not be completed for ${topic}.
